templates.display_name: A Woman Remembered - Five Bettys Collage
templates.mood: cream editorial ground, painterly fine-line texture, cool-neutral
composition_zones: all five Bettys arranged in visually balanced layers
prompt_blocks: A square character-and-product illustration on cream editorial ground.
All five Bettys arranged in visually balanced layers; perfume near the foreground.
Accurate amber cylinder with gold hardware at both ends; the transparent real label read lengthwise.
Iris pallida, blush rose, jasmine and pear.
Soft sage and ivory, cool enough to belong on the current site; painterly fine-line texture, not monochrome sepia.
templates.reference_notes: Anchor on the last explicitly approved botanical five-Betty collage.

prompt_blocks: One Betty and one small ritual.
Limited background, no heavy borders, ample breathing room.
templates.reference_notes: Good for Brownstone Tote, Scented Letter, Reading Hour and fragrance.

composition_zones: five recognizable chapters in a row with linked features
prompt_blocks: Five recognizable chapters of one woman, with linked shared features and distinct ages and outfits.
prohibited_substitutions: baked-in labels or copy - keep these as separate web typography layers
templates.reference_notes: Editorial storytelling, NOT a product specification image.

composition_zones: jade wax seal with exact flower emboss
prompt_blocks: Golden Betty or Betty Remembered depending on the story; a cream letter, a jade wax seal with the exact flower emboss, a writing desk, an understated scent gesture.
prohibited_substitutions: a full commercial perfume bottle - the letter is not one
templates.reference_notes: Choose the character by story; never swap the Golden and Remembered inspirations.

prompt_blocks: Present Betty in a navy crewneck, wide-leg denim and square black glasses.
A brown slouchy faux-suede tote sized and stitched according to its product reference, with the correctly patterned silk scarf.
prohibited_substitutions: an invented tote shape or stitching
templates.reference_notes: Requires the tote product reference for size and stitching.
